convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators with simple entry/exit rules, fixed lot sizing, and standard MQL5 trade objects. External .mqh includes (Normal.mqh, PositionInfo.mqh, Trade.mqh, Expert.mqh) are standard MQL5 library utilities that don't add custom trading logic. Sell logic is commented out, making the active logic straightforward.

other_exits: Sell logic is commented out so there is no opposite-side entry to close a buy; no explicit close-on-reversal logic exists

custom_logic_notes: Sell entry block is entirely commented out (lines 274-323), so only long trades are active. Take profit for buy uses MA_Val1[0] (Fast SMA value) instead of a fixed pip TP, despite TKP being calculated. Buy_Condition_1 checks if MA5 minus Close is below -0.0015, meaning price is significantly above the fast MA. Buy_Condition_2 checks if the fast MA is rising (current > 2 bars ago). Magic number in buy order is hardcoded 15489 instead of using EA_Magic input (12345). Margin check has a bug: 'margin' variable is uninitialized when compared to free_margin, so the check is effectively meaningless. The Normal.mqh include is unused in trading logic. CSymbolInfo m_symbol is declared but never used.
python_conversion_notes: Sell logic is commented out but should be included in Python conversion as it is a complete strategy half. The margin check bug (uninitialized variable) should be fixed in Python by either properly calling OrderCalcMargin or removing the check. The hardcoded magic number 15489 in the buy block should use the EA_Magic input parameter. Take profit for longs is indicator-based (Fast SMA value), not fixed pips—this needs special handling in Python. The digit adjustment (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be preserved. Standard MQL5 library includes are scaffolding only and don't need Python equivalents.
